headline: The Game Awards December 10
title: The Game Awards 2026 Date December 10 | Peacock Theater | Gaming News
video_script: The Game Awards twenty twenty six is set for December tenth in Los Angeles at the Peacock Theater, hosted by Geoff Keighley. Nominees are expected to be announced in mid November. The ceremony hands out Game of the Year and many other awards, and it is also where new game reveals often drop. Which game should win Game of the Year? Comment below!
description: The Game Awards 2026 takes place December 10, 2026 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Sources: Nintendo Life, Insider Gaming, Games.gg, Gameswelt.
